risk: No physical evidence exists for any dish or beer
why it matters: Every design score and every hypothesis rests on reasoning only
what reduces it: Cook Session 1 and the following sessions; a qualified brewer pilot

risk: An Austin restaurant named Nasha (Indian Tex-Mex fusion with a bar) already exists per T1 searches: HIGH NAME-CONFLICT RISK (D-78)
why it matters: Same word, city and class with adjacent cuisine; possible likelihood of confusion; all name-dependent brand, domain and signage spend is exposed
what reduces it: IP attorney clearance review now; founder decision on keep/modify/fallback shortlist; no further name-dependent spend or public use until decided

risk: No lawful structure may exist to link food and beer before a brewery exists (H11)
why it matters: Could break the staged MVP path and the pairing idea
what reduces it: Texas alcohol attorney; commissary/health checks; food-only first tests

risk: The fusion may read as gimmick or caricature (H2, H8)
why it matters: Brand and cultural credibility are the product
what reduces it: Cultural advisor review; blinded tasting; dish-by-dish cut/rework rule

risk: Unit economics are unknown (no price, yield, rent, labour, quote)
why it matters: Cannot size capital or pricing; investors will not engage
what reduces it: Real receipts and quotes; scenario model with provenance classes

risk: Brewery scale and economics conflict with the building concept (50 bbl canon vs small demand)
why it matters: Capex could be mis-sized by an order of magnitude
what reduces it: Brewer-led sizing; pilot-first; do not size from renders

risk: Customer demand and willingness to pay are untested (H1, H5, H10)
why it matters: The business may not be wanted at a workable price
what reduces it: First-30 learning plan; thresholds frozen in advance; paid tests last

risk: Kitchen bottleneck (comal and labour) and goat handling may limit the menu
why it matters: The Core 5 may be unexecutable at pace
what reduces it: Time real steps; cut or rework the weakest dish; operating-day requirements

risk: Identity-critical ingredients (nixtamal tortillas, goat, paneer without bovine rennet) may be hard to source to specification
why it matters: D-54 and cultural identity could be compromised
what reduces it: Supply-spec table; label checks; supplier declarations before any claim

risk: AI-generated imagery and planning could be mistaken for evidence
why it matters: Credibility loss with professionals and investors
what reduces it: Lane separation, stage labels, evidence audit, concept-only rule

risk: Founder-dependence: one person running cooking, legal, research and outreach
what reduces it: Short review packages, prioritised queue, parallel workstreams
Responsible-alcohol principles; image checklist; attorney and broker review
